resources.string: Tap any of the 8 features to run it right away — watching (Player) and broadcasting (Streamer). No need to read the docs first.

No built-in demo keys — fill in local.properties or enter your own keys below.
You only need two values. The stream token is required for Mission 8 only.

Validation only checks the key format. The SDK has no API to verify keys up front, so real validity shows up on first playback as an error event — reported as invalid key / campaign not found / authentication required / network.
The code is not in the app. Read it in the demo project shipped alongside — every feature card names the file to open.
Your input is stored only on this device (EncryptedSharedPreferences) and is never sent to a server.
⚠️ The Keystore is unavailable on this device, so values are stored in plain SharedPreferences. They still never leave the device.

⚠ Engine switching is never reported as an event. HLS↔WebRTC failover is internal to the SDK; network conditions surface only through playback rebuffering and connectionStateChanged.
⚠ Issues being auto-recovered do not arrive as error. An error is delivered only when a session ends unrecoverably (isRecoverable = false).
type sets the defaults for volume-key policy and resolution. LIVE = volume keys allowed, live resolution / PREVIEW = volume keys blocked, preview resolution (less traffic).
Pick the authentication method on the Mission 3 card. It applies from the next playback.
Only this group applies mid-playback. configuration is immutable, so assignments after start are ignored.
Unlike configuration, these can differ on every start()/play() call.
OS PIP is full-screen (Activity) only. Enabling it has no effect on an embedded view — the whole host Activity is what shrinks, so a single view cannot be shown alone.
HIDDEN only hides the UI. The command channel stays alive, so product and coupon data keeps arriving — watch the log tab. An embedded view is always HIDDEN (video only).
In the current SDK version, enabling this makes playback bounce into PIP (reproduced on a real device). Turn it on for inspection only.

Setting this to false makes the SDK apply FLAG_SECURE to the player window, so video shows up black in screenshots, mirroring, and screen recordings. (The docs list false as the default, but the implementation default is true.)
Every field has a default, so it works without being set. Tap a value to cycle to the next one.
Below is a ShoplivePlayerView. Your app owns only the layout; controls, events, and PIP use the same API as full screen. An embedded view shows video only (no overlay UI).
An embedded view requires an Activity (LifecycleOwner) context. It cannot be created with applicationContext.
No campaignKey. Enter your keys via ⚙.
An embedded view offers in-App PIP only (OS PIP is full-screen only)
Promoting to full screen re-fetches the stream in the current version — handover without a re-fetch is upcoming SDK work.
This screen is the result of your app routing navigation(url).
PIP — playback shrinks into a small window and continues when you navigate away. (default)
KEEP — the player is left as it is.
navigation is the only request your app must handle. Without routing, tapping a product does nothing.
Exit PIP and return to full screen

How should we identify the user?
You can mix methods in one app; the choice applies from the next playback.
simple auth (the SDK generates a client token)
Invalid key — accessKey is not set. Call initialize first.
Campaign not found — check the campaignKey.
The campaign is not on air. Check whether it is VOD and its scheduled time.
Network — check your connection. (The SDK is attempting automatic recovery.)
accessKey contains whitespace. Check whether it was truncated when copied.
English is the default. This is an app-level setting and does not follow the device language.
Playback keeps failing (code %1$s). The campaign may not be on air, or it has no playable stream. The SDK retries every few seconds — the screen stays black until a stream is available.
Playback failed (code %1$s) — campaign may not be on air
